components.name: AIService Interface
components.description: Core AI service interface defining standard methods for all LLM providers. Supports streaming output, tool calls, thinking/reasoning mode, token counting, input token calculation, and connection testing. Returns Stream<String> for all responses.
key_methods: sendMessage() - with enableThinking, availableTools, preserveThinkInHistory params
getModelsList() - fetches available models per provider
release() - resource cleanup for local models

components.name: AIServiceFactory
components.description: Central factory for creating AIService instances based on ApiProviderType. Manages shared OkHttpClient with HTTP/2, connection pooling, SSL bypass, and custom header injection. Supports single/multi API key rotation.

components.name: OpenAIProvider

components.name: OpenAIResponsesProvider
components.description: OpenAI Responses API format for OPENAI_RESPONSES and OPENAI_RESPONSES_GENERIC provider types

components.name: ClaudeProvider
components.description: Anthropic Claude format provider for ANTHROPIC and ANTHROPIC_GENERIC. Supports Claude prompt caching.

components.name: GeminiProvider

components.name: MNNProvider
components.description: MNN local inference engine. Uses com.ai.assistance.mnn.MNNLlmSession native library. Supports CPU/OpenCL/OpenGL/Vulkan backends, multimodal (vision/audio/video via llm_config.json flags), hardware-accelerated inference, native tokenization, binary search history trimming, and StructuredToolCallBridge for tool call conversion.
key_features: Backend types: cpu(0), opencl(3), auto(4), opengl(6), vulkan(7)
Preprocessing: image<>, audio<>, video frame extraction via FFmpeg
Tool calls via Jinja template context injection and XML conversion
Sampling params: temperature, topP, topK, minP, penalty, tfsZ, typical, nGram

components.name: LlamaProvider
components.description: llama.cpp local inference engine. Uses com.ai.assistance.llama.LlamaSession native library. Supports GGUF models, chat template application, native tool call grammar, streaming generation with cancellation.
key_features: Config: nThreads, nCtx, nBatch, nUBatch, nGpuLayers, useMmap, flashAttention, kvUnified
Tool calls via parseToolCallResponse or StructuredToolCallBridge
Sampling: temperature, topP, topK, repetition/frequency/presence penalty

components.name: StructuredToolCallBridge
components.description: Converts between XML tool call format (<tool_name><param>...</param></tool_name>) and structured OpenAI function calling JSON format. Handles both API-side tool definitions and response parsing. Normalizes various tool call formats from different providers.
key_functions: buildToolsJson() - for llama.cpp native tool call
buildMessagesJson() - converts PromptTurn history to OpenAI messages format
convertToolCallPayloadToXml() - converts JSON tool calls to XML

components.name: ModelConfigManager
components.description: Per-model configuration CRUD with DataStore persistence. Manages API keys (single/pool), endpoints, model names, provider type, MNN/llama hardware settings, multimodal flags (vision/audio/video), tool call toggle, prompt cache, Google Search Grounding, context length, auto-summary settings, and custom parameters.

components.name: ModelListFetcher
components.description: Fetches model lists from various provider endpoints. Supports OpenAI-style /v1/models, Gemini, Claude, and local model discovery (MNN directory scan, llama.cpp GGUF file listing). API key masking for security.

details: Operit v1.12.0 features an extremely comprehensive ModelProvider system with 23+ distinct ApiProviderType values and 34 Kotlin files in the llmprovider package. The AIService interface unifies all providers. Two local inference backends are implemented: MNN (Alibaba's inference engine with multimodal support) and llama.cpp (GGUF local inference). StructuredToolCallBridge provides XML-to-JSON tool call conversion that works across both cloud and local providers. Configuration is stored in a dedicated DataStore with full per-model parameter control including custom parameters of any type (INT/FLOAT/BOOLEAN/STRING/OBJECT). The system supports multi-API-key rotation, per-provider rate limiting, and request concurrency control.
notes: MNN uses .mnn model format with llm_config.json capability flags (is_visual, is_audio, max_all_tokens)
llama.cpp uses GGUF format with native chat template application
Tool calls use XML markup format internally (<random_tag name="tool"><param name="key">val</param></random_tag>)
All providers support streaming output via the Stream<String> return type
The factory also supports dynamic JS-based providers via ToolPkgAiProviderRegistry
MediaLinkBuilder/Parser enables inline image/audio/video references in messages
OpenAI Responses API is a distinct provider from standard OpenAI chat completions
The SherpaMnnSpeechProvider in the MNN module provides local STT via sherpa-mnn (separate from the LLM MNN)
